description: House branch guard: denies the enumerable ways to disable or move the git-hook floor that enforces a repo's branch policy, and commits on a protected branch, in repos that opt in via house.json. Arms the floor (core.hooksPath) at session start, logs InstructionsLoaded events, the rule-load positive control `house doctor` reads, injects the orchestration defaults (roster, model tier, briefs, verification) at session start (plus, weekly and detached, a local scan of your transcripts that surfaces a one-line notice when idle cache rebuilds cost real money), warns on resume when an expired prompt cache makes the first message a costly context rewrite, and holds the first typed prompt once after an idle gap that expired the cache.
